mapper.insert: INSERT INTO genomic_audit_logs (tenant_id, user_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, detail, ip_address) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{action}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{detail}, #{ipAddress})
mapper.select: SELECT a.audit_id AS auditId, a.user_id AS userId, '' AS userName, a.action, a.resource_type AS resourceType, a.resource_id AS resourceId, a.detail, a.ip_address AS ipAddress, a.created_at AS createdAt FROM genomic_audit_logs a WHERE 1=1 AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.action = #{action} AND a.resource_type = #{resourceType} ORDER BY a.audit_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
